cards.detail: Steam still gives the Dear Passengers game a broad 2026 window. No month, day, price, or preorder has been announced.
FLEXUS plans a public Dear Passengers game demo after its Gamescom build, but there is no public date or download.
Windows PC is the only announced platform. Console, Mac, Linux, VR, and Steam Deck plans remain open.
Single-player and online co-op are confirmed. Maximum crew size, split screen, and crossplay are not stated.

latestOfficialUpdate.headline: Full plane control confirmed; actual-flight video in production
latestOfficialUpdate.summary: FLEXUS reported two million wishlists and said it was producing a video showing an actual flight. The wishlist figure is developer-reported—not a sales or active-player count—and no video date was given.
